headline: Husson sets the NAC scoring pace
dek: Husson has scored 43 goals across all matches while conceding fifteen, compiling ten wins, two draws and six losses. Thirteen different scorers have contributed to that total, which exceeds the combined output of UMaine-Farmington, VTSU Lyndon, UMaine-Presque Isle and VTSU Johnson.

pattern.label: derived
pattern.text: Scoring across the conference splits sharply between its upper and lower halves: even Maine Maritime's 29 goals surpass the combined totals of UMaine-Farmington, VTSU Lyndon, UMaine-Presque Isle and VTSU Johnson.

wire.line: Member programs have won ten, drawn eight and lost 35 outside the conference, conceding 135 goals and scoring 35.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Lesley has conceded five goals while scoring 23 across all matches, compiling five wins, one draw and one loss.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Husson defender Thea Gerfen has recorded nine assists and three goals on 33 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Thomas goalkeeper Emily Rock has made 120 saves while allowing 25 goals for a 0.828 save percentage.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Maine Maritime freshman Harlow O'Leary has scored ten goals and added four assists on 64 shots.

findings.label: observed
findings.text: Nine matches on the schedule have passed their dates without a published result, including Husson against University of New England and Thomas against Southern Maine.

last_match.line: Husson arrived having beaten Maine Maritime and Lesley without conceding.
